stories.title: Sources: Vikings inquiring about QBs ahead of trade deadline
stories.summary: The Vikings have started making calls around the league about trading for a quarterback ahead of Tuesday's deadline, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Sources: Jaguars plan to keep WR Thomas Jr. through trade deadline
stories.summary: The Jaguars plan to keep wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr. through the trade deadline, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

stories.title: Sources: Bengals add edge rusher Ebiketie in trade with Eagles
stories.summary: The Bengals have added edge rusher Arnold Ebiketie in a trade with the Eagles, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Rutgers to keep coach Schiano despite back-to-back losing seasons
stories.summary: Coach Greg Schiano will return to Rutgers for his 19th season, the school announced Tuesday, despite back-to-back losing seasons.
